name: אֶלְחָנָן
summary: אֵל “God” with the verb חָנַן “has been gracious”, the same name as Johanan with El for Yahweh. Borne by two of David's warriors: Elhanan son of Jaare-oregim of Bethlehem, who struck down the brother of Goliath the Gittite (2Sa 21:19; 1Ch 20:5, “Lahmi the brother of Goliath”), and Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem, one of the thirty (2Sa 23:24; 1Ch 11:26).

evidence.note: “אֶלְחָנָן son of Jaare-oregim the Bethlehemite struck …”
“Elhanan son of Jair struck Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite.”
“Elhanan son of Dodo of Bethlehem”, among the thirty.
The verb with אֱלֹהִים as subject: “the children whom God has graciously given (חָנַן אֱלֹהִים)”.

note: Takes a.dl.ah (4 tokens), BDB's key under אלה. 2Sa 21:19 as written reads “struck Goliath”; 1Ch 20:5 reads “struck Lahmi the brother of Goliath”, and the summary follows Chronicles. The reading of the name is the form, אֵל + qatal.
